why_this_method.value: Single-dish GBT used to capture extended emission

evidence.quote: highlight the potential contribution that single-dish observations can have for studying molecular emission on large spatial scales

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Metal-poor inflowing gas argued against by lack of enhanced [CI] emission

evidence.quote: The lack of a strong enhancement of \[C i\] emission for SMM02399 (Walter et al. 2011) argues strongly against the scenario of W1 resulting from metal-poor inflowing gas.

limitations_admitted.value: GBT cannot spatially disentangle excitation; alpha_CO for component A is highly uncertain.
